text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ah, here you go, ma'am! Please, take a seat!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, thank you kindly~.
Here, if you'd like this as a little token of thanks...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Good deeds taste like carrot candy"... Got it!
Make sure to write this down—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
T-That's right... Taking notes on the train
makes me... all dizzy... I forgot...

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
"Oh dear! Are you alright?!
Let's get off together at the next station...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Sakura Chiyo no O had intended to help someone, but ended up needing care herself due to motion sickness...
